translation_notes: AAS = Namespace(...) becomes '@prefix aas: <...> as AAS .': 'as AAS' is unused here (nothing else in the region needs the Namespace object) but kept for provenance/readability; a plain '@prefix aas: <...> .' would do just as well.
CD_TYPE = rdflib.URIRef(AAS['ConceptDescription']) -> 'aas:ConceptDescription': the surrounding rdflib.URIRef(...) call was redundant (a prefixed name is already a URIRef) and dropped.

ID = rdflib.URIRef(AAS['Identifiable/id']): the local part contains a literal '/', which is not typeable as a bare prefixed-name suffix. Used 'aas:{"Identifiable/id"}' (computed local part from a Python string) rather than the lexical form, since it concatenates without re-encoding the slash -- exactly what the original AAS[...] indexing does.

This module has no Graph and its only module-level value is a class, which rdfeval.harness._values excludes (classes have no meaningful __eq__): wrote a custom driver.py that compares the three class attributes (AAS, CD_TYPE, ID) directly instead of the generic entry=None module-state comparison.
